consequence.statement: LogCLI used the store from -boltdb.shipper.shared-store to fetch remote schema; the store for remote schema is now configured with -schema-store.
consequence.remediation: Set -schema-store to the store used for retrieving remote schema.

assertion.statement: LogCLI no longer takes the remote schema store from -boltdb.shipper.shared-store when -remote-schema is true; the new -schema-store flag replaces it.
